attack_description: Independent from-scratch reimplementation of PHR=100*AHEW/EEW, Rv=PHR*(rho_A/rho_B) (Ellis 1993 equivalents algebra), and their full-chain GUM LPU combined standard uncertainty (JCGM 100:2008 sec.5.1 eq.10, covariance-aware: ratio_by_volume's uncertainty carries the AHEW/EEW terms through the PHR chain, not just the two density terms), reading facts.json LIVE rather than trusting the receipt's cited values, for all 3 hardener systems (ancamide_350a, versamid_115, ancamide_2353) x DGEBA DER-331 the receipt worked. Cross-checked with an independent 400k-draw Monte Carlo (own RNG seed, not a byte-replay of the receipt's MC). Positive control: the same reproduction re-run with the volume-ratio density term inverted (rho_B/rho_A instead of rho_A/rho_B) -- the exact convention-confusion defect class the receipt's own KA4 probe exists to catch -- to confirm this check has the power to detect a defect of the kind it is being trusted to rule out.
observed_result: The real (undefected) re-derivation reproduces all 3 hardener systems' phr_by_weight and ratio_by_volume point estimates AND full-chain LPU combined uncertainties to <1e-6 relative, using facts.json values read live rather than trusted from the receipt. The independent Monte Carlo cross-check (own seed) confirms the LPU standard uncertainty within the declared 2% Monte-Carlo-noise budget for all 6 (system x quantity) probes. The positive control confirms this reproduction has the power to detect the convention-confusion defect class its target claim exists to rule out: inverting the density ratio moves ratio_by_volume.point by 14.85-19.59% (matches the receipt's own convention_confusion.worst_case_abs_index_deviation_pct figures almost exactly, since that is precisely what this defect computes).

positive_control.how_planted: compute_system(hid, defect_swap_density_ratio=True) inverts density_ratio and its two partial derivatives in this script's own reproduction of the receipt's formula, applied to the SAME live facts.json inputs used for the real check above.
positive_control.planted_defect: ratio_by_volume computed as PHR*(rho_B/rho_A) instead of PHR*(rho_A/rho_B) -- the weight-spec-poured-by-volume convention confusion the receipt's own KA4/convention_confusion probe names and quantifies (worst_case_abs_index_deviation_pct ~15-20% in the receipt itself).

refutation_criterion: Would REFUTE if: (a) any independently re-derived point estimate or LPU combined uncertainty deviates from the signed receipt's value by more than 1e-6 relative for the real (undefected) formula, OR (b) the independent Monte Carlo standard deviation deviates from the receipt's LPU u_c by more than 2% relative (would indicate a linearization or covariance-handling bug), OR (c) the positive-control defect (density-ratio inversion) fails to move ratio_by_volume.point by more than 1e-6 relative (would mean this check has no power to catch the failure mode it exists to catch, per the 2026-08-05 loop self-correction on unfalsifiable attacks).
